_comment: Maps raw application status codes to student-friendly language, next step, and optional eta_days (estimated days to the next step). Synthetic for capstone.

DRAFT.next_step: Complete all required fields and submit the application.

SUBMITTED.human_status: Material completeness check in progress (Demo / Mock Status)
SUBMITTED.next_step: No action is needed now. If there is a material issue, the admissions team will request supplementary documents; otherwise the application will proceed to formal review.

UNDER_REVIEW.next_step: No action is needed. A decision is expected within 2–3 weeks.

DOCS_REQUIRED.next_step: Please upload the missing files as soon as possible to avoid delaying review.

OFFER.next_step: Please confirm whether you accept the offer before the deadline.

WAITLIST.next_step: No action is needed now. You will be notified if places become available.

REJECTED.next_step: You may contact the admissions office for feedback or consider the next application round.

ACCEPTED.next_step: Please monitor follow-up instructions for registration and fee payment.
